limitations: Preparation requires bounded namespace-entry facts and container extraction, but consumes only their JSON-safe descriptor state and never receives live archive, filesystem or installation capabilities.
Every multiplay/maps/<id>/game.map is a candidate; multiple candidates require an explicit opaque selectionId and are never reduced to the first entry.

The selected map root stays mounted from the opened subject, while base.wz and mp.wz use the generic desktop game-installation archive resolver with configured-path, MODKITX_WARZONE_ROOT or automatic discovery.
The contribution prepares a workspace and resource plan only; rendering, runtime elevation, footprints, full material semantics, scripts and portable UVD remain outside this service.
